behavioralRed.result: Six assertions failed only because the dedicated ServiceAccount, exact read-only ClusterRole/binding, projected token and configured token/CA paths were absent.
After correcting a resources-order test defect, the chart failed only on Web/Job termination grace and MySQL non-root/read-only/drop-ALL behavior.
Production inline Secret data and simultaneous Ingress/HTTPRoute rendered instead of being rejected.
Default/component policies, DNS/MySQL/integration allowlists and the reviewed 0.0.0.0/0 override boundary were absent.
Independent review proved namespace-wide default denial and missing external-MySQL CIDR/port egress before both were corrected.

gates.summary: Rendered RBAC, pod security, Secret refs/schema, network isolation, rollout/PDB, namespace safety and external-MySQL contracts pass.
1 chart linted, 0 charts failed; only the informational icon recommendation remains.
The prior P6-T1 filesystem/S3 and migration topology contract remains green.
Default render passes; release digests are not checked in non-production mode.
Production security structure passes with in-memory render-contract digest fixtures; output explicitly reports release-digests=render-contract-fixture-release-pending.
